finding.message: URL parameter from Flask request.args is passed directly to requests.get() without domain validation.
answers: url originates from flask.request.args.get('url') — fully user-controlled.
No allowlist or scheme validation is applied to the URL before the HTTP call.
requests.get() is the sink making the outbound HTTP request.
Attacker supplies http://169.254.169.254/latest/meta-data/ to access cloud metadata.
